name: Life Admin
summary: Remembers the dull dates: renewals, bills, appointments and documents. Reminds you ahead of time and knows where things are.

optional.why: to find renewal notices, bills and appointment confirmations
to see appointments you've already booked

examples: My passport expires in August next year
Car insurance renews on the 14th of March
Where did I put the boiler warranty?
What's coming up in the next two months?
